description.DOKTOR HONORIS CAUSA AGH: The honorary doctorate awarded by AGH University of Science and Technology is the highest honorary academic title and distinction bestowed upon individuals with significant or outstanding contributions to science, technology, culture, industry, or society, as well as those associated with the university but not active employees. The degree recognizes significant contributions to a particular field and outstanding achievements. Examples of recipients include Adam Jan Bielański, Stanisław Gołąb (1969), Krupkowski (1964), Zbigniew Górny, Herbert Wilhelm Wirth (2013), Zbigniew Osiński.
description.HISTORIA AGH: The AGH history project, department, resource, or system is dedicated to documenting and preserving the history of AGH University of Science and Technology. This initiative takes the form of various resources, including a website, online archive, database, wiki, or other digital platform. It aims to provide historical information about the university, its departments, disciplines, key events, notable figures, research, and related topics. The project is responsible for maintaining and publishing historical records, documenting the university's past, personnel, and achievements. The main goal is to present and disseminate knowledge about AGH's history and heritage to the public. The URL historia.agh.edu.pl is associated with this project.
description.SENAT AGH: The Senate of AGH University of Science and Technology is the university's highest governing and decision-making body. It is responsible for making key decisions and setting policies regarding academic, administrative, and strategic matters, including university policies and regulations, the approval of budgets, and the setting of overall direction. The Senate is composed of elected representatives of academic staff, students, and administrative staff. Its responsibilities include approving regulations and resolutions related to the Doctoral School, as well as conferring honorary titles such as Doctor Honoris Causa and Honorary Consul, and awarding the "Zasłużeni dla AGH" title. The Senate also approves statutes and oversees academic and administrative matters.
description.AKADEMIA G\u00d3RNICZO-HUTNICZA IM. STAN: AGH University of Science and Technology, located in Krakow, Poland, is a public technical university focused on innovation and technology in technical, scientific, earth, and social sciences. Its full official name was adopted in 1969. The university also awards postgraduate diplomas and honorary doctorates. It is a partner university in the UNIVERSEH consortium and serves as the data controller in certain contexts.
description.AGH: AGH University of Science and Technology, also known as Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza im. Stanisława Staszica w Krakowie (AGH UST), is a technical university located in Krakow, Poland. It is frequently referred to by its abbreviation, AGH University of Science and Technology, or simply AGH. Jerzy Lis holds various positions within the university. Researchers at AGH University of Science and Technology are involved in studying pollution. The Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science is part of AGH University of Science and Technology. AGH University of Science and Technology also hosted MCAA conference.
description.BIULETYN INFORMACYJNY PRACOWNIK\u00d3W A: The AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) publishes an internal information bulletin for its employees. This publication serves as a key communication channel, providing news, updates, and official information relevant to the university community. The bulletin covers a wide range of topics, including university events, activities, decisions, achievements (such as honorary doctorates), and personnel-related matters. It also features articles about individuals associated with AGH, such as Zbigniew Gorny, Roman Ney and Giennadij Grigoriewicz-Piwniak. The bulletin is available to all AGH staff and aims to keep them informed about university life.
description.BIULETYN AGH: The "AGH University of Science and Technology Bulletin" (also referred to as "AGH Bulletin" or simply "AGH's Bulletin") is the official publication of AGH University of Science and Technology. This periodical functions as an internal bulletin/magazine and newsletter. It disseminates information related to university life, research, events, achievements, and news relevant to the university community, employees, and members. The bulletin includes articles, announcements, and highlights of academic activities, personal achievements, and research conducted at the university. It serves as a key source for university-related information. Mentions exist of the bulletin featuring information about honorary doctorates awarded to Eugeniusz Świtoński and Jan Kiciński.
description.BIBLIOTEKA G\u0141\u00d3WNA AGH: The Main Library of AGH University of Science and Technology is the central library of the university and one of the largest technical libraries in Krakow and Poland. It serves as a resource center and event venue, including an exhibition hall. The library provides a wide range of resources, tools, and services to support learning, teaching, and research for students, faculty, researchers, and staff. These services include access to physical and electronic resources, scientific communication support, information services, and access to Legimi ebook service. The library also plays a role in verifying scientific publications and organizing conferences.  It is responsible for managing the university's collections. The library underwent expansion and modernization during Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship.
description.BAZA DANYCH O AUTORACH I PUBLIKACJACH AG: The AGH Database of Authors and Publications is a system and resource maintained by AGH University of Science and Technology to track research output and scholarly activities. It serves as a comprehensive database containing information about authors affiliated with AGH and their publications. The database catalogs publications associated with the university, providing access to academic research output. It is an internal system used to track research output. It is designed for indexing authors and publications associated with AGH University. The database is used to manage and provide information about AGH employees and their scientific publications.
description.AKADEMIA G\u00d3RNICZO-HUTNICZA: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a leading technical university in Poland, located in Krakow. It is an institution of higher education. The text may refer to its current name, former name, or historical name. The full name of the university is AGH University of Science and Technology, and the full Polish name is [Polish name - need to fill in based on available knowledge, since it wasn't provided]. It is also referred to as AGH.
description.WELCOME POINT:
AGH University offers a comprehensive support service and information point for both new students and visitors, with a particular focus on assisting international students, researchers, and academic staff. This service acts as a central contact point providing essential guidance and support on a wide range of topics, including:

*   **Orientation and Navigation:** Helping newcomers navigate the university's resources and services, providing information about the AGH campus, and assisting with initial inquiries.
*   **Practical Matters:**  Assisting with settling in Krakow, including information on accommodation, transportation, opening bank accounts, and other practical aspects of daily life.
*   **Administrative Support:**  Providing guidance and support with administrative processes, such as PESEL registration, visa requirements, and legalisation of stay.
*   **Socio-Cultural Adaptation:**  Assisting with socio-cultural adaptation, language barriers, and providing information on leisure, culture, and sports activities in Krakow.
*   **Family Support:** Offering information and assistance related to childcare and schooling options for those relocating with families.
*   **Pre-Arrival Assistance:** Providing assistance and information to prospective international students and researchers even before their arrival in Poland.
*   **Departure Assistance:** Providing assistance and guidance to international students before their departure from Poland

This service is designed to be the first point of contact for international students and visitors, ensuring a smooth transition and a positive experience at AGH University. It provides essential information about Poland and acts as a helpful resource for navigating various challenges.
description.MUZEUM HISTORII AGH: The AGH University History Museum is an archive and exhibition facility dedicated to preserving, showcasing, and documenting the history and heritage of AGH University of Science and Technology. It serves as a historical archive and repository for historical documents and artifacts related to the university, archiving information on important people and events. The museum also provides materials and information about the university's history and notable figures, acting as a reference source.
description.POCZTA AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology provides an email system for its students, faculty, and staff. This system, referred to as the AGH Email System, AGH Email service, or AGH's mail/email system, serves as the primary method of internal communication within the university. It is dedicated to enabling communication between students, employees and faculty of the university.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 IN\u017bYNIERII MECHANICZNE: The Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) specializing in mechanical engineering and robotics. Formerly known as Wydział Maszyn Górniczych i Hutniczych, it is responsible for education and research in these fields. Notable figures associated with the faculty include Zygmunt Kawecki, Zbigniew Osiński (who received an honorary doctorate from the faculty), Janusz Kowal (who served as Dean and Prodziekan), and Adam Morecki (who worked at the faculty and also received an honorary doctorate). The faculty organizes courses in mechanical engineering and robotics.
description.SKLEP INTERNETOWY AGH: The AGH Online Store is the official online store of AGH University of Science and Technology. It offers a variety of AGH-branded merchandise and publications, as well as potentially other university-related items and educational materials. The store is managed and operated by AGH University, providing various products and services to students and others associated with the university. It may also be referred to as AGH Internet Shop or simply AGH's Online Shop.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 IN\u017bYNIERII MATERIA\u01: The Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) that specializes in materials engineering and ceramics. It was established in 1971 and is a successor faculty to the Wydział Ceramiczny at AGH UST.
description.MIASTECZKO STUDENCKIE AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) Student Campus is an organizational unit and a large student housing complex located in Poland, comprising multiple dormitories and related facilities. It provides accommodation and related services to students, PhD students, and employees.  The campus manages student dormitories and encompasses recreational areas, sports facilities such as football, basketball, volleyball, and tennis courts, and other student life facilities.
description.AKADEMIA G\u00d3RNICZA: The AGH University of Science and Technology, founded in 1919, was previously known under a different name. This historical name, used until 1949 and during the tenure of Professor and Rector Jan Studniarski, reflects the university's origins as a mining academy. The term is a former or original name, sometimes used as a shortened or historical reference to the institution.
description.OPEN AGH \u2013 OTWARTE ZASOBY EDUKACYJN: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) provides open educational resources through its Open Educational Resources initiative/platform/program. This initiative aims to provide free and accessible educational and learning materials for public use. The initiative is known as "Open Educational Resources initiative at AGH", "Open AGH - Open Educational Resources", "Open Educational Resources platform at AGH University" and "AGH's Open Educational Resources".
description.USOS: The University Study-Oriented System (USOS), also known as Uniwersytecki System Obsługi Studiów, is AGH University's primary academic information system and core system for student management and academic administration. It is a comprehensive IT system used to manage student data, academic records, course information, course registration, scheduling, and grades. It supports various study-related processes, including thesis submissions, scholarship applications, and other administrative functions. USOS is a student information system implemented at AGH and many other Polish universities. It is a system used for student services, applications, and communication between students and staff. USOS is likely a component of USOSweb.
description.Doktor Honoris Causa AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology awards honorary doctorates (also referred to as honorary degrees or honorary doctoral degrees) as its highest honorary degree. The degree is bestowed upon individuals for outstanding or exceptional achievements and/or for significant contributions to science, culture, the national economy, and the university itself.  Jerzy Grzymek received the honorary doctorate in 1979, and Stanisław Marian Knothe also received this distinction from AGH University.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 FIZYKI I INFORMATYKI STOSOW: The Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science at AGH University of Science and Technology (also referred to as Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science at AGH UST or Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science at AGH) is a faculty (Wydział) at AGH University of Science and Technology specializing in physics and applied computer science. It was formerly known as the Międzyresortowy Instytut Fizyki i Techniki Jądrowej and was renamed in 2004. The faculty primarily uses Pawilon D-11 and gained a new pavilion (D-7) during Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship. The faculty is also involved in the KM3NeT experiment.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 GEOLOGII, GEOFIZYKI I OCHRO: The Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) that focuses on geology, geophysics, and environmental protection. It was formerly known as the Faculty of Geology and Exploration. Roman Ney and Tadeusz Słomka both worked at this faculty, with Tadeusz Słomka serving as Vice-Dean and Dean.
description.CELIID AGH: The Centrum e-Learningu i Innowacyjnej Dydaktyki (Center for e-Learning and Innovative Didactics) is an organizational unit and department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) dedicated to educational development and innovation. It focuses on supporting and improving teaching and learning methodologies, promoting innovative educational practices, and providing educational resources, including e-learning solutions. The center is involved in developing teaching skills, fostering project-based learning, enhancing communication and visual thinking skills, and supporting life-long learning and well-being. It also hosts webinars and oversees or publicizes tutoring programs. Formerly known as AGH's Center for Language and Information Innovation, the center also focuses on language and IT didactics. The ultimate goal is to cultivate excellence in teaching and learning at AGH.
description.REKTOR AGH: The Rector of AGH University of Science and Technology holds the highest authority and administrative position within the university. The Rector is responsible for the overall management, representation, and strategic direction of the institution. Key duties include issuing regulations, appointing the Library Director and Deputy Directors, and selecting the institution managing PPK. The Rector also makes decisions on appeals regarding acceptance into the school and grants permission to use the AGH graphic mark. Notable past Rectors include Witold Budryk (1956-1958) and Tadeusz Kochmański (1961-1963). The Rector's office serves as the highest administrative authority at AGH University.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 ENERGETYKI I PALIW: The Faculty of Energy and Fuels is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow. It focuses on energy-related studies, research, and education, particularly in the fields of power engineering and fuels. The faculty is also involved in collaborative research with the Shibaura Institute of Technology.
description.AKADEMICKIE CENTRUM MATERIA\u0141\u00d3W: The Academic Centre for Materials and Nanotechnology (ACMiN) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is an interdisciplinary academic research center and institution dedicated to research and development in materials science and nanotechnology. ACMiN manages and provides access to specialized research equipment and services, offering expertise in these fields. The center also focuses on education within nanotechnology and advanced materials. ACMiN represents also building on AGH. The center was also a construction project at AGH.
description.MAIN LIBRARY: The central library of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) serves as the primary library facility for the entire university community, including students, faculty, and researchers. It provides access to a wide range of academic resources, research materials, scholarly resources, and study spaces, both physical and electronic. The library offers resources and services to support the academic and research needs of AGH University's students, faculty, and staff.
description.SZKO\u0141A DOKTORSKA AGH: The AGH Doctoral School at the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is an organizational unit responsible for doctoral education. It manages and coordinates doctoral studies programs, including international mobility programs like Erasmus+. The school oversees doctoral programs, dissertation processes, and postgraduate studies, providing doctoral education and research opportunities. Its primary function is to manage the doctoral education process and PhD programs. The AGH Doctoral School focuses on advanced research studies.
description.STUDIA PODYPLOMOWE: Postgraduate studies at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) encompass a wide variety of specialized programs designed for professionals and graduates who have already completed a bachelor's or master's degree. These postgraduate programs, also referred to as postgraduate (diploma) programs or graduate certificates/diplomas, provide advanced knowledge and skills in specific fields. They are offered across various faculties, including the Faculty of Management and the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Electronics (WIET), covering diverse areas like cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI), and medicine. The postgraduate studies programs are available in various fields of study.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 METALI NIE\u017bELAZNYCH: The Faculty of Non-Ferrous Metals is a faculty/department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Poland. Established in 1962, the faculty focuses on education and research in non-ferrous metal production and processing, non-ferrous metallurgy, recycling, metal processing, and related fields. Its work encompasses non-ferrous metals material engineering and processing. The faculty also collaborates with WITI (presumably another entity within or associated with AGH) on joint projects.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 ODLEWNICTWA: The Faculty of Foundry Engineering is a department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is responsible for education and research in foundry engineering. The faculty underwent renovations during Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship. It also collaborates with the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering on the 'Technologie Przemysłu 4.0' major.
description.PROFESOR HONOROWY AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology awards an honorary title, also referred to as an Honorary Professorship, to distinguished scholars, engineers, or other individuals, including professors, for outstanding achievements and significant contributions to the university, its development, and its fields of study. This title, awarded by the AGH Senate, represents the highest form of recognition bestowed by the university. It acknowledges lifetime achievements in science, teaching, and organization, as well as contributions to specific fields like tribology (as in the case of Stanisław Jerzy Pytko, awarded in 2009). Examples of recipients include Adam Klich (awarded in 2012), Wojciech Mitkowski, and Janusz Krzysztof Kowal. Janusz Kowal was awarded the title by the AGH Senate.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 IN\u017bYNIERII L\u0104DOWE: The Faculty of Civil Engineering and Resource Management at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a faculty focusing on civil engineering and resource management. Formerly known as the Mining Faculty and the Faculty of Mining and Geoengineering, its current name, reflecting its focus, was adopted in 2021. The faculty is involved in various international projects related to raw materials and mining.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 G\u00d3RNICZY: The Faculty of Mining at AGH University of Science and Technology is the first faculty established at Akademia Górnicza (later AGH). It focuses on mining and geology and mining-related disciplines. The Department of Drilling and Exploitation of Oil was established here. The foundations of the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection were laid at the Mining Faculty. Jan Studniarski (1921/1922), Hoborski and Stanisław Marian Knothe, Stanisław Gołąb served as Dean. Zygmunt Bielski-Saryusz worked at the Faculty.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 ELEKTROTECHNIKI, AUTOMATYKI: The Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering (WEAIiIB) is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow. It focuses on electrical engineering, automation, computer science, and biomedical engineering. Formerly known as Wydział EAIiE, the faculty gained a new pavilion (D-2) during Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship. Wojciech Mitkowski is currently affiliated with this faculty.
description.AGH UNIVERSITY STUDENT CAMPUS: The AGH University student campus is a large residential area and dormitory complex providing accommodation and related facilities for students and visiting scholars of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It encompasses all dormitories and student housing facilities at AGH, serving as the primary residential area for students attending the university. The campus includes a comprehensive collection of dormitories, estimated at around 20, along with associated services such as shops, a post office, and student clubs to support student life. The complex is managed by an administrative unit responsible for overseeing the AGH student campus.
description.AGH E-SKLEP: The official online store of AGH University of Science and Technology offers a variety of university-themed merchandise, apparel, accessories, stationery, publications, and promotional items. The store sells AGH-branded products and other university-related goods.
description.ERASMUS+: Erasmus+ is an international exchange program funded by the European Union that supports education, training, youth, and sport in Europe. It facilitates student and staff mobility for study and internships abroad at partner universities and institutions worldwide. AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) actively participates in the Erasmus+ program, providing opportunities for its students, including doctoral students and those from the Faculty of Humanities, to study or work abroad. The AGH Main Library is also involved in Erasmus+ programs. The program provides funding for international mobility and academic exchange, which AGH students can utilize for opportunities such as the Spring School. Erasmus+ is classified as an exchange program and a scholarship program.
description.GRANT REKTORA: The Rector's Grant at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a funding program designed to support student research projects and initiatives. This competitive scheme, managed by the Rector, aims to foster practical knowledge, skill development, and engagement in scientific endeavors for students. The grant supports both individual student projects and those undertaken by student research groups and scientific circles. It is a specific financial support mechanism offered to student organizations for specific projects. The program is governed by competition rules ('Regulamin konkursu').
description.BADAP: The AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) maintains a comprehensive system for managing and displaying information about authors and their publications. This system, referred to as the AGH Bibliographic Database, serves as a central repository for publications and achievements of AGH UST employees. It aggregates data on authors and their works, providing a searchable database of publications. The system facilitates the collection, sharing, and browsing of publication data within the university. It functions as a bibliographic database and bibliography portal, listing publications from AGH employees and managing researcher profiles. This system is a key resource for accessing AGH University's publications.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 IN\u017bYNIERII MATERIA\u01: The Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics at AGH University of Science and Technology (also referred to as Wydział Inżynierii Materiałowej i Ceramiki Akademii Górniczo-Hutniczej) is a faculty/department specializing in materials science, materials engineering, and ceramics. It focuses on research and education in these fields and also offers the Ceramics program.
description.WYDZIA\u0141: A Faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a primary academic and administrative unit, representing a specific academic discipline or area of study. As a major organizational unit, each faculty focuses on a specific field of study and research. It is composed of multiple departments (Katedras) and is responsible for academic programs. AGH comprises 16 such faculties/departments. Faculties deliver specific fields of studies, and they may provide additional funding for student projects or invite international guests and manage their allowances. It's an academic division that can be referred to generically and requires specialization to specify the exact faculty (e.g., Wydział Elektrotechniki, Automatyki, Informatyki i Inżynierii Biomedycznej or a faculty offering social media and content marketing studies). The term is used for official documentation.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 IN\u017bYNIERII METALI I IN: The Faculty of Metals Engineering and Industrial Computer Science is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It specializes in metals engineering and industrial computer science. The faculty is also one of the faculties that underwent renovations during Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship.
description.KONSUL HONOROWY AGH: The Honorary Title awarded by AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is bestowed upon individuals for their significant contributions to the university. These contributions encompass various aspects, including the university's development, promotion, international collaborations, and the fostering of its alumni network. The title recognizes active promotion of the university and its scientific achievements in industry, as well as the development of didactic and research cooperation with other universities. Contributions to the internationalization of students and institutional collaborations are particularly valued. Notable recipients include Leopold Jeziorski, recognized for his long-term scientific cooperation and promotion of the university, Igor Cependa for his contribution to international collaboration and promotion of the university and professor Akito Takasaki. The AGH Senate also awards the honorary title for contributions to the university's international cooperation and positive image.
description.PROREKTOR DS. STUDENCKICH: The Vice-Rector for Student Affairs is a key administrative position at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) responsible for all student-related matters. This includes overseeing student affairs, policies, and decisions, as well as managing and allocating funds such as the Grant Rektora program and FNKS funding. The Vice-Rector's office handles communications, organizes the Grant Rektora competition, and oversees student organizations. The Vice-Rector also approves applications for student travel abroad, handles appeals regarding Zapomoga decisions, and serves as the supervisory body for accessibility complaints. The current Vice-Rector for Student Affairs is prof. dr hab. Rafał Dańko. The Vice-Rector is also a member of the Jury responsible for managing scholarship funds.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 WIERTNICTWA, NAFTY I GAZU: The Faculty of Drilling, Oil and Gas is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) focused on education and research related to drilling, petroleum, and gas engineering. The faculty offers programs in drilling, petroleum engineering, and related fields. During Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship, the faculty gained a new pavilion (D-2).
description.INICJATYWA DOSKONA\u0141O\u015aCI \u2013: The "Excellence Initiative - Research University" (IDUB) is a program and project at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) aimed at enhancing the university's research capabilities, quality, and international recognition. As part of a larger initiative from the Polish Ministry of Science and Higher Education, it supports research-intensive universities in Poland. The program's goals include improving the international reputation of AGH, fostering research excellence, integrating education with scientific research, and achieving excellence in specific priority areas. It is likely involved in funding student projects and research and is intended to enhance research quality and international collaboration at AGH.
description.SEKCJA WYP\u0141AT I ROZLICZE\u0143 STYP: The Section for Payments and Settlements of Scholarships is a vital part of the Student Affairs Department (Dział Spraw Studenckich) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). As a dedicated department, its primary function is the management, processing, disbursement, and settlement of scholarships and other financial aid to students. Located in building C-1, room 111, the section handles all aspects of scholarship payments and settlements, ensuring students receive the financial support they are entitled to. It serves as a key organizational unit responsible for disbursing scholarship funds and managing payments related to scholarships.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 HUTNICZY: The Faculty of Metallurgy is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), established in 1920. It is focused on the study of metals and metallurgy, historically including foundry-related studies.  Wacław Olszak lectured in the Department of Engineering and Construction at the faculty. Krupkowski served as Dean. Feliks Olszak and Franciszek Kaim studied at the Faculty of Metallurgy.  Wacław Adam Leskiewicz started his career at the Faculty of Metallurgy (under a former name). The faculty has also been referred to as the Metallurgical Faculty of AGH University (a historical name, which may have changed) and formerly related to or a part of Akademia Górnicza (AGH).
description.MS AGH: Miasteczko Studenckie AGH (AGH Student Campus) is the student housing complex at AGH University of Science and Technology in Krakow. It's a system of multiple dormitories, also referred to as Domy Studenckie, managed by a dedicated administration. This administration, also known as Administracja Miasteczka Studenckiego AGH, is responsible for managing all aspects of student housing, including room reservations through an online system. The campus also includes sports facilities where various sports events take place. In essence, Miasteczko Studenckie AGH encompasses the student dormitories, their administration, and related sports facilities at AGH University.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 HUMANISTYCZNY: The Faculty of Humanities at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a faculty focusing on humanities subjects. It offers courses and support in humanities, with a particular focus on the intersection of humanities and technology. Building projects for the Faculty of Humanities at AGH were prepared during Tadeusz Słomka's rectorship.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 INFORMATYKI AGH: The Faculty of Computer Science is a department within AGH University of Science and Technology in Krakow.
description.DZIA\u0141 SPRAW STUDENCKICH AGH: The Student Affairs Department at AGH University of Science and Technology (also referred to as AGH UST's Student Affairs Department or AGH's Student Affairs Department) is a department responsible for student-related matters. Its responsibilities include student-related administrative matters and services, administering scholarships and student aid, overseeing student organizations, handling student loans, managing competitions and funding for student research groups, and providing student support.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 METALURGII I IN\u017bYNIERI: The Faculty of Metallurgy and Materials Science/Engineering is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) focused on metallurgy and materials engineering. Note that there is also a Faculty at Politechnika Częstochowska where Leopold Jeziorski was a dean (this might be a different, albeit related, faculty).
description.AGH UNIVERSITY: AGH University of Science and Technology is a leading technical university located in Krakow, Poland. It consistently ranks highly in national and international rankings and is a primary academic institution. The university offers research infrastructure and expert opinions. AGH University of Science and Technology cooperates with KS Cracovia SA and is part of the Agreement of Krakow Doctoral Students. It also participates in the EPO's MIPEF program and hosts events such as the Cultural Orientation Workshop and various seminars. The university is known for its engineers who win awards.
description.Senat AGH: The Senate of AGH University of Science and Technology is the highest governing and decision-making body at the university.  It is a collegial body comprised of representatives from various faculties and departments.  The Senate is responsible for setting the university's strategic direction, approving key policies and regulations, and making key decisions regarding the university's structure, operations, academic affairs, and administrative matters.  Its responsibilities include approving changes to the university's structure and statutes, as well as awarding honorary doctorates. It plays a role in decisions related to faculty structure and name changes. The Senate functions as a committee.
description.CAREERS CENTRE: This is a career support service and organization at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It provides career guidance, career planning, and job placement assistance to both current students and university alumni. The service offers a range of support including career advice, job search assistance, internship opportunities, and professional development resources. The goal is to help students and graduates find employment opportunities and successfully navigate their career paths.

The Dean is also responsible for the administration and resources of the faculty. This involves approving student projects, assigning teams to review nostrification applications (recognition of foreign degrees), and more generally overseeing the academic activities within the faculty. The Dean represents the faculty within the university and is responsible for the educational programs offered by the faculty. The position is currently held by Ewa Kmiecik.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 GEOLOGICZNO-POSZUKIWAWCZY A: The Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It was formerly known as the Faculty of Geology and Exploration and focused on geological exploration. Herbert Wilhelm Wirth graduated from this faculty. Józef Antoni Dubiński studied geophysics at the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection at AGH University.
description.KRZY\u017b OFICERSKI ORDERU ODRODZENIA P: The Officer's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta is a Polish state decoration and order. It is awarded for outstanding achievements. The composer Henryk Górecki received this award.
description.AKADEMIA G\u00d3RNICZO-HUTNICZA W KRAKOW: AGH University of Science and Technology, located in Krakow, is an organization. The provided texts refer to the Polish name of AGH University of Science and Technology, indicating it is a university in Poland. Some departments within the university are responsible for project management. The texts mention both former and current names of the institution, suggesting a name change occurred at some point.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Odlewnictwa: The Faculty of Foundry Engineering at AGH University of Science and Technology is a faculty/department at the university. It was split from Wydział Hutniczy (likely the Faculty of Metallurgy) in 1952.
description.KO\u0141A NAUKOWE: Student research groups, also known as scientific circles, are student organizations active within AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). These groups are often organized by department or field of study and are engaged in various scientific projects and activities. They focus on specific academic disciplines, scientific fields, or projects, providing students with a chance to pursue their own research and learn from each other. They exist within various faculties, including the Faculty of Foundry Engineering, the Faculty of Energy and Fuels and the Faculty of Management. These groups conduct research and projects in various fields.
description.INSTYTUT TELEKOMUNIKACJI: The Institute of Telecommunications is a department within the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications (WIET) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It specializes in telecommunications research and education. The institute is responsible for implementing agreements with companies like Comarch. It is one of the institutes within WIET specializing in telecommunications.
description.TELEINFORMATYKA: Teleinformatics is a major/course of study offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), specifically within the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications (AGH WIET). It is a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program, and also offered as a postgraduate course. The major is innovative and focuses on IT and the practical application of telecommunications systems, networks, and software development. It is also a major often pursued by graduates of the 'Elektronika' program.
description.IN\u017bYNIERIA BIOMEDYCZNA: Biomedical Engineering at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a multifaceted entity encompassing education and research. It's offered as a field of study, specifically a first-cycle (undergraduate) program. The Biomedical Engineering major is a comprehensive course that applies engineering principles to medicine and biology. The program is offered by the Biomedical Engineering department at AGH. Additionally, Biomedical Engineering serves as a research area and discipline, including the scope for habilitation degrees.
description.STUDIUM WYCHOWANIA FIZYCZNEGO I SPORTU A: The Study of Physical Education and Sport (or Department of Physical Education and Sport) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is the department responsible for physical education and sports activities for students. It manages sports facilities, including sports halls, gyms, and an aerobics room, and is responsible for organizing sports programs.
description.C-7: The entity is a building on the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) campus, specifically located at ul. Czarnowiejska 36.  It houses the Student Affairs Department (Dzial Spraw Studenckich).  Since October 1, 2022, it has also become the new location of the Faculty of Humanities.  The building is also used for faculty teaching purposes and is currently under construction.
description.WMS AGH: The Faculty of Applied Mathematics at AGH University of Science and Technology, abbreviated as Wydział Matematyki Stosowanej AGH, is an organizational unit within AGH University of Science and Technology.
description.AUTOMATYKA I ROBOTYKA: Automation and Robotics is a major/field of study at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) focused on the design, implementation, and maintenance of control systems for technical objects and technological processes. It is offered as a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program, and is related to Automatics and Robotics. The major is available at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering (WEAIiIB) at AGH UST.
description.WEAIiIB: The Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering (Wydział Elektrotechniki, Automatyki, Informatyki i Inżynierii Biomedycznej) is a department/faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is often abbreviated. The faculty is mentioned in the context of publication affiliations.
description.PROGRAM ERASMUS+: Erasmus+ is a European Union student exchange program that promotes international academic mobility. AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) actively participates in the Erasmus+ program, offering opportunities for both students and staff to study or undertake internships abroad. The program is coordinated by the Dział Współpracy z Zagranicą (International Relations Office) at AGH. Erasmus+ fosters cooperation in education and supports student and staff mobility.
description.AKADEMIA G\u00d3RNICZO-HUTNICZA (AGH): AGH University of Science and Technology, located in Krakow, Poland, is a leading technical university in Poland. It is focused on mining and metallurgy. The full official name is AGH University of Science and Technology in Krakow, Poland. It is an organization classified as a university and faculty.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 GEODEZJI G\u00d3RNICZEJ: The Faculty of Mining Surveying (also referred to as Faculty of Mining Geodesy, Faculty of Mining Surveying and Environmental Engineering, or Faculty of Geodesy) is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH University). It focuses on mining geodetics and geodesy related to mining and surveying. Tadeusz Kochmański served as Dean of the Faculty, and Stanisław Gołąb headed the Katedra Matematyki I (Department of Mathematics I) at the Faculty.
description.WILiGZ: This entity is a faculty/department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) named **Wydział Inżynierii Lądowej i Gospodarki Zasobami**, which translates to **Faculty of Civil Engineering and Resource Management**.  It is also potentially related to mining, or could be confused with Faculty of Mining Surveying and Environmental Engineering. Daria Polek, a PhD student involved in the HoloGEM project, belongs to this faculty.  It should not be confused with Faculty of Fuels and Energy at AGH UST.
description.WGGiO\u015a: The entity is the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection (WGGiOŚ) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is also referred to as Wydział Geologii, Geofizyki i Ochrony Środowiska in Polish. The Department of General Geology and Geotourism (Katedra Geologii Ogólnej i Geoturystyki) is part of this faculty. There is also a mention of "Faculty of Mining Surveying and Environmental Engineering" and "Potentially Wydział Geodezji, Geoinformatyki i Ochrony Środowiska (Faculty of Geodesy, Geoinformatics and Environmental Protection) at AGH UST", the latter requiring verification. The entity is classified as both a FACULTY and a DEPARTMENT.
description.DOCTORAL SCHOOL: The described entity is an ORGANIZATION within AGH University responsible for all aspects of doctoral studies. This encompasses coordinating, administering, and managing doctoral programs, as well as overseeing doctoral education and research programs. It is a graduate-level institution and a dedicated school/department/division within AGH specifically for PhD studies and postgraduate doctoral studies. It functions as the primary administrative unit for doctoral candidates at AGH.
description.BIURO REKTORA AGH: The Rector's Office at AGH University (also referred to as the Office of the Rector at AGH University of Science and Technology) is a central administrative unit and a key organizational department. It supports the Rector of AGH University and oversees various university operations. The office is responsible for administrative oversight and handles complaints related to digital accessibility.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 ODLEWNICTWA AGH: The Faculty of Foundry Engineering is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology. It specializes in foundry engineering, focusing on research and education in casting technologies and related areas. The faculty is also associated with the E-CHEMIA resource. Zbigniew Górny obtained his doctorate degree at the Faculty of Foundry Engineering at AGH.
description.Z\u0141OTY KRZY\u017b ZAS\u0141UGI: The Golden Cross of Merit is a Polish civilian state decoration awarded for services to the state. It is a state award of Poland presented to individuals for distinguished service to the country. Notably, Henryk Górecki and Tadeusz Słomka, affiliated with AGH University, have received this award. The AGH page lists the AGH-affiliated recipients of the Golden Cross of Merit.
description.Akademia G\u00f3rniczo-Hutnicza im. Stan: AGH University of Science and Technology, formerly known by other names, is an organization located in Krakow. It is also referred to by its full name, which is its current and most recent official name.
description.SYLABUS AGH: The AGH course syllabus is a **document** and **system**, specifically a **resource** containing course descriptions and information for programs like Teleinformatyka offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It's the official document outlining the curriculum, learning outcomes, and assessment methods for courses. This centralized repository (sylabusy.agh.edu.pl) serves as AGH's syllabus database system, publishing course descriptions and academic plans.
description.OFFICE FOR DOCTORAL STUDENTS' AFFAIRS: The entity is a DEPARTMENT and SERVICE provided by AGH University Doctoral School. It functions as an administrative unit and support office responsible for handling all matters related to doctoral students. This includes managing administrative tasks, student-related issues, admissions, and providing comprehensive support services. The department is dedicated to doctoral student affairs within the AGH University Doctoral School.
description.EXCELLENCE INITIATIVE \u2013 RESEARCH UN: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) participates in a strategic program (also referred to as a project and initiative) aimed at enhancing its research capabilities, research excellence, and international standing. The program focuses on achieving recognition as a leading research university, improving its global influence, and enhancing its overall university standing. This program is a Ministerial program aimed at selecting and supporting the best Polish universities to become research universities.
description.IDUB: The "Inicjatywa Doskonałości – Uczelnia Badawcza" (Initiative of Excellence – Research University), often shortened to "Initiative of Excellence - Research University", is a program/project at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) aimed at enhancing and improving the quality of research and education. It focuses on funding and developing scientific activities within the university and supports the careers of young scientists. The program is associated with the Granty Rektora competition and is supported by the Ministerial programme "Initiative of Excellence – Research University".
description.STUDENT: This entity refers to a **PERSON** who is an **AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST)** **student**. This includes students enrolled in **undergraduate (I or II degree)**, **doctoral**, programs at AGH.  Specifically, it refers to AGH students actively **participating in the 'Grant Rektora' project**. This group is also a **user group with restricted access to certain functionalities**. Moreover, a student of AGH can apply for financial support (**Zapomoga**) if they are affected by a natural disaster.
description.Rektor AGH: The Rector is the highest administrative authority at AGH University of Science and Technology, responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the university. The Rector's Office is the highest administrative body within the university. The current Rector is Jerzy Lis.
description.AKADEMIA G\u00d3RNICZO-HUTNICZA IM. STAN: The AGH University of Science and Technology, also known as AGH UST, is a university officially named the AGH University of Science and Technology.
description.FACULTY OF CIVIL ENGINEERING AND RESOURC: The Faculty is an academic unit at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow. It is one of the faculties at AGH University, focusing on civil engineering and resource management studies. The faculty is involved in research on ventilation, air quality, and resource management and also participates in the project "Energy Transition Entrepreneurs in Action". It offers studies related to civil engineering and resource management.
description.Z\u0142oty Krzy\u017c Zas\u0142ugi: The Gold Cross of Merit is a Polish civilian state decoration awarded for services to the state. It is a Polish civilian award of merit and a Polish civilian decoration of merit.
description.WGGIOS: The Wydział Geologii, Geofizyki i Ochrony Środowiska (Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection), often abbreviated, is a faculty or department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It's also referred to as the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection at AGH. The faculty is likely related to Geodesy, Geophysics, and Environmental Engineering.
description.AGH NAUKA: "This entity represents a recurring series of meetings, lectures, and discussions related to science and technology, organized by AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is a program consisting of science-related events, including popular science lectures, focused on various scientific topics and research. The entity can be categorized as an organization, a program, and an event."
description.CENTRUM KOMUNIKACJI I MARKETINGU: The Communication and Marketing Center at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a department responsible for a wide range of communication and marketing activities. Its duties include public relations, media contact, university promotion, brand management, and internal communication. The Center also manages the university's visual identification and handles branding-related inquiries. It is responsible for disseminating information about the university and managing media relations.
description.WIMiC: The Wydział Inżynierii Materiałowej i Ceramiki (Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics) is a faculty (or department) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is also referred to as the Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics at AGH University. While potentially related to metallurgy, its core focus is on materials science and ceramics. There is a possible confusion with Faculty of Metals Engineering and Industrial Computer Science at AGH UST, so it should be verified.
description.DZIA\u0141 ZAM\u00d3WIE\u0143 PUBLICZNYC: The Public Procurement Department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is responsible for managing and overseeing all public procurement processes. This includes handling tenders, ensuring legal compliance, and managing the execution of public procurement processes at the university. The department coordinates all aspects of public procurement within AGH.
description.DZIEKAN: The Dean of a Faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is the head of the faculty, representing the highest administrative authority and holding the position of Dean. The Dean is responsible for the management and academic direction of the faculty, including academic administration and overseeing matters related to study programs, student admissions, and student-related issues such as scholarship payments. The Dean chairs the Kolegium Wydziału and has the authority to make decisions, including the recognition of competency requirements. The Dean is responsible for managing academic affairs and approving student-related matters.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 MASZYN G\u00d3RNICZYCH I HU: The Faculty of Mining and Metallurgy Machinery was a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It focused on mining and metallurgical machinery.  Several individuals held leadership positions within the faculty, including Jan Anioła (Dean), Józef Kazimierz Giergiel (Dean), and Zygmunt Kawecki (Vice-Dean).  Other notable individuals associated with the faculty include Adam Klich, Andrzej Maria Gołaś, and Janusz Kowal, who began his career there. The faculty is now potentially known as or part of the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics.
description.ECTS: The European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System (ECTS) is a standard designed to compare the study attainment and performance of students in higher education across the European Union and other collaborating countries. It serves as a standard for quantifying study achievements. ECTS points represent the workload and learning outcomes of a course.  The system provides a way to indicate the credit points a student earns in a program, for example, 60 ECTS credit points.
description.COMPUTER SCIENCE: Computer Science at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow is a multifaceted entity encompassing academic programs, research, and publications. It is a field of study dedicated to the study of computation and information. At the bachelor's level, it is offered as a first-cycle (bachelor's degree) study program at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering. AGH University Press publishes scientific journals, including a quarterly journal, dedicated to theoretical and applied computer science research. Computer Science is a significant research area within the university.
description.UCZELNIANA RADA SAMORZ\u0104DU STUDENT\u: The AGH University Student Government Council, also known as the University Student Government Council at AGH UST and the Student Government of AGH University of Science and Technology, is the student government organization at AGH University of Science and Technology. It represents all students of AGH University of Science and Technology, advocating for their interests and welfare. The council organizes events such as 'Laur Dydaktyka AGH' and has a representative on the jury for the "Mozaika w Studenckim Centrum Konstrukcyjnym AGH" competition.
description.CENTRUM REKRUTACJI: The AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) has a central **Recruitment Center** (also referred to as Central Recruitment office) that functions as both an **organization** and a **service**. It is responsible for managing the application and admissions process for prospective students. This includes providing information to prospective students, handling student admissions, and overseeing the overall application process. The Recruitment Center manages the admissions process.
description.POCZET REKTOR\u00d3W AKADEMII G\u00d3RNI: This is a document or resource that lists the rectors of AGH University of Science and Technology throughout its history, documenting its leadership history. This includes the periods when the university was known as the Mining Academy (Akademia Górnicza) and Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza. The document details the succession of rectors at AGH. It serves as a historical record or gallery of past rectors.
description.SHIBAURA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (SIT): Shibaura Institute of Technology is a Japanese technological university located in Tokyo, Japan. It is a key international partner of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), with a long-standing collaboration and partnership. This partnership encompasses research collaborations, student exchanges, joint doctoral programs, student internships, and other joint initiatives, fostering scientific and academic exchange between the two institutions.
description.Biuletyn Informacyjny Pracownik\u00f3w A: The entity is a publication, specifically an internal newsletter and information bulletin for employees of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH). This publication contains information about university activities, news, and events relevant to AGH employees. It is referred to by several names, including: Internal newsletter for AGH employees, Information Bulletin of AGH employees, Internal newsletter for employees of AGH University, AGH Employee Information Bulletin, Information Bulletin for employees of AGH University of Science and Technology, Newsletter of AGH University of Science and Technology, and Information Bulletin for AGH Employees.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Fizyki i Informatyki Stosow: The Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science (WFiIS) is a faculty/department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST/AGH University). Dr. Paweł Janowski is affiliated with this faculty.
description.BUNKIER NAUKI: Science Bunker is a recurring science-related event series organized by AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It also functions as a science outreach project at AGH and a science popularization channel created in 2022. It takes the form of a wideopodcast series, where AGH scientists discuss their work and engage in discussions about important contemporary problems and research, focusing on science and technology topics. This AGH resource aims to present academic insights and engage the public with science.
description.CENTRUM ENERGETYKI AGH: The AGH Energy Center is a research and development center and department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow. It functions as both a research and scientific center and a research and educational center. Its primary focus is on the development of energy technologies and energy-related projects through research and education. The center houses laboratories and research facilities and offers commercial services and research collaborations.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 ELEKTROTECHNIKI G\u00d3RNIC: The Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Mining and Metallurgy was a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It has had several names throughout its history, including the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Mining and Metallurgy; Faculty of Mining and Metallurgical Electrical Engineering; and the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics and Electronics at AGH. It is the former name of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automation, and Electronics at AGH University. Several notable individuals studied or worked at this faculty, including Wojciech Mitkowski, Wojciech Hubert Żurek (who completed his master's degree there), and Andrzej Maria Gołaś.
description.WMS: The Faculty of Applied Mathematics (Wydział Matematyki Stosowanej) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a faculty/department at the university. The abbreviation "Wydział Matematyki Stosowanej" likely refers to this entity.
description.EUGENIUSZ \u015aWITO\u0143SKI: This individual is a professor specializing in automation, robotics, and mechanics, holding the title of Doktor Honoris Causa from AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). They are associated with the Mechanika department and represent several research areas at AGH, including 'Analiza Wrażliwości' (Sensitivity Analysis), 'Dynamika Maszyn' (Machine Dynamics), Optimization, Biomechanics, and Automatyka i Robotyka (Automation and Robotics). Furthermore, they are linked to numerical methods and have been awarded the Brązowy Krzyż Zasługi (Bronze Cross of Merit) at AGH. More details about them can be found in historical resources pertaining to AGH.
description.AGH SPACE SYSTEMS: This entity is a student organization, specifically a student research group and design team at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). Founded in 2014, the group is dedicated to space-related projects, rocketry, and the development of space industry technologies. Their activities include designing and building modular and liquid-fueled rockets, developing subsystems for these rockets, and working on planetary rover projects. They also conduct biological research utilizing rockets and stratospheric balloons and are currently building a prototype bioreactor for cell cultures in space conditions. The group is supervised by dr inż. Mariusz Gibiec from the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics (WIMiR).
description.C-1: This building, designated as a FACILITY, is located on the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) campus at al. Mickiewicza 30. It houses the International Relations Office and IT support services. The building also features a reception area where documents can be submitted.  Specifically, it's the location of the Sektor Ekonomiczny (Economic Sector) and the Accounting Department, whose contact person is located on the ground floor in a specified room.
description.CENTRUM KARIER AGH: The AGH Career Center is an organization within AGH University that provides a comprehensive range of services to support students and alumni in their career development. These services include career counseling, CV consultation, job search assistance, and providing career advice. The center offers information on job opportunities, internships, and training resources. It also focuses on job placement and tracks employment statistics for AGH graduates. A possible involvement in the HoloGEM project via Janusz Grząśko is mentioned. Additionally, the center conducts research on graduate employment. In Polish, it is referred to as "Biuro na AGH zajmujące się wsparciem studentów i absolwentów w rozwoju zawodowym, pośrednictwem pracy, stażami i praktykami."
description.CYBERBEZPIECZE\u0143STWO: Cybersecurity at AGH University is offered as a field of study within the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications (WIET). It is available as an undergraduate (first cycle) and postgraduate (second cycle) major, and is also available as a postgraduate course. The major and course focus on security measures and the protection of IT systems, networks, and data, addressing the security of IT systems. The field of study and research area are within the Teleinformatyka curriculum.
description.BIURO ADMINISTRACYJNE WYDZIA\u0141U:
The entity is a **Faculty Administrative Office** located within AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It exists at various faculties, including:

*   Faculty of Drilling, Oil and Gas
*   Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering (WEAIiIB)
*   Faculty of Metals Engineering and Industrial Computer Science.

The entity is categorized as both an **ORGANIZATION** and a **DEPARTMENT** within the university structure.
description.IGNIS:
This entity represents a multifaceted initiative encompassing both a student research group and a groundbreaking space mission related to AGH University.

On one hand, it refers to a Student Research Group (also described as a Student Research Club) associated with the Faculty of Energy and Fuels at AGH, supervised by mgr inż. Wojciech Kalawa from WEiP. This group focuses on remote-controlled research vessels.

On the other hand, it signifies the first Polish technological and scientific mission to the International Space Station (ISS).  This Polish space mission to the ISS includes the "MXene in LEO" experiment.  The mission is a project of considerable importance, marking Poland's entry into space-based technological and scientific endeavors.
description.CENTRUM WSP\u00d3\u0141PRACY I TRANSFERU: The AGH UST Center for Cooperation and Technology Transfer is a unit within AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is responsible for facilitating collaboration and technology transfer activities between the university and external entities, including industry. The Center's activities focus on commercializing research results, preparing technologies for implementation and commercialization, and supporting spin-off companies. It also plays a key role in intellectual property protection. Initiatives like Akademia Przedsiębiorczości fall under its purview. In summary, it is a key organizational unit at AGH focused on bridging the gap between academic research and practical application in the wider world.
description.AGH NAUKA SPOTKANIA: AGH Science Meetings is a series of science-related meetings and events organized by AGH University of Science and Technology. These meetings serve as a science popularization event series, promoting scientific knowledge and engaging with the public. The program focuses on various scientific topics and research areas.
description.STRA\u017b AGH: The AGH University security service is an organization responsible for maintaining order and security on the university campus. Its duties include the protection of AGH assets, access control, managing parking access, and ensuring campus safety. It is the primary security force of AGH University.
description.CENTRUM TECHNOLOGII KOSMICZNYCH AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology houses the Space Technology Center (also referred to as Space Technologies Center or AGH Center for Space Technologies), a research center dedicated to research and development in space-related fields. Its focus encompasses space technologies, orbital and planetary missions. The center aims to develop space technologies and foster collaboration between academia and the space industry. Projects include experiments such as the MXene in LEO experiment. It is involved in various space-related research and projects and is considered a research unit within AGH University.
description.ENERGETYKA: Power Engineering at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a field of study focused on energy and power engineering. It's offered as a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program at the Faculty of Energy and Fuels (WEiP). Power Engineering serves as a major field of study for doctoral degrees awarded by AGH. It also represents a research area at AGH, and a course offered at the university.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 CERAMICZNY: The Faculty of Ceramics at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) was a faculty focused on ceramic materials. It existed from 1952 to 1971. The Faculty of Ceramics was a predecessor to the present-day Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics Engineering at AGH UST, and it has been renamed several times throughout its history, including Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics and Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics Engineering.
description.UCZELNIA: AGH University of Science and Technology, also known as Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza im. Stanisława Staszica w Krakowie, is a higher education institution (university). The name "University" or the abbreviation "AGH" are commonly used references to the institution, especially in internal documents and legal contexts.
description.ELEKTRONIKA: Electronics at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a major field of study and research area offered at the Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications (WIET). It's available as a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program. The focus of the Electronics major encompasses electronics, automation, robotics, and telecommunications. It also includes postgraduate courses specializing in Electronics. Within the broader Teleinformatics curriculum, Electronics represents a specific major or field of study concentrating on electronic systems.
description.VIVAT AKADEMIA : AGH: "This is a publication related to AGH University of Science and Technology. It functions as a magazine or newspaper, promoting the university's activities, academic life, and achievements. It is an academic journal published by AGH University."
description.UNESCO AGH CHAIR: The UNESCO Chair at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is an organizational unit and academic chair affiliated with UNESCO. It focuses on a variety of areas related to UNESCO's mandate, including science, technology, and engineering, particularly in the context of sustainable development. Specific areas of focus include: promoting sustainable development through engineering solutions, water-related issues and resource management, multiculturalism, education, and global understanding. The Chair promotes research and education in these specific areas and also handles applications for the UNESCO fellowship. It promotes engineering and sustainable development initiatives.
description.ELEKTRONIKA I TELEKOMUNIKACJA: Electronics and Telecommunications is a major/program/course offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) at both Bachelor's (first-cycle, undergraduate) and Master's (postgraduate) levels. It is offered at AGH's Faculty of Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications (WIET). The program focuses on electronics and telecommunications engineering, and related research areas within the Teleinformatyka curriculum are focused on electronic and telecommunication systems. description.FACULTY OF ENERGY AND FUELS: The Faculty of Energy and Fuels (Wydział Energetyki i Paliw) is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow.
