description.RYSZARD TADEUSIEWICZ: This individual is a highly accomplished Professor at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) with expertise in biocybernetics, automation, and computer science. He served as the Rector of AGH UST from 1998 to 2005. He is associated with Biocybernetics at AGH and has been awarded the title of 'Profesor Honorowy AGH'. Furthermore, he received the Krzyż Komandorski z Gwiazdą Orderu Odrodzenia Polski. He supervised Dagmara Stasiowska's doctoral thesis. As Rector, he supported the establishment of the Faculty of Humanities.
description.NEWSLETTER BGINFO: This is a newsletter service provided by Biblioteka Główna AGH (the Main Library of AGH University). The newsletter aims to keep the user base informed by disseminating information and updates about the library's services, news, events, resources, training opportunities, and trial access opportunities.
description.INFORMATYKA MEDYCZNA: Medical Informatics is a first-cycle (bachelor's level) field of study offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) by the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering. This full-time program focuses on the application of computer science to medicine and healthcare, including areas such as healthcare systems management, medical diagnostics, and the broader application of computer science within the medical field. It is an undergraduate major related to Medical Computer Science.
description.BADAP AGH: Baza Danych AGH (AGH Database), is a system used at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) for managing and displaying information about authors and publications. It serves as a publication database system and bibliographic and activity data archive portal. The system is also used for evaluation purposes, potentially related to research output and achievements. It is presumably an internal system or database, potentially for data management or administration.
description.KRZY\u017b KOMANDORSKI ORDERU ODRODZENIA: The Commander's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta is a Polish state decoration. It is awarded for outstanding achievements and contributions to the nation. It was awarded to Henryk Górecki.
description.AGH SOLAR PLANE: This entity is a student organization at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), specifically a student research club/group. Its primary focus is the design, construction, and development of solar-powered aircraft. These aircraft are intended for various applications, including long-duration field missions, mapping and object detection, and humanitarian aid. The club also focuses on solar-powered gliders. The group is supervised by dr inż. Krzysztof Sornek, and also by dr hab. inż. Krzysztof Sornek, prof. AGH from the Faculty of Energy and Fuels (WEiP)
description.Historia AGH: The AGH history resource is an organizational project dedicated to documenting and archiving the history of AGH University of Science and Technology. This resource takes the form of a historical archive, department, website, collection, or database. It serves as a central repository for historical information about the university.
description.IN\u017bYNIERIA G\u00d3RNICZA: Mining Engineering is a major offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), specifically within the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Resource Management (WILiGZ). It is the current name of the original mining and geology study program at AGH. It's a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program focused on Mining Engineering. Completion of a postgraduate program in underground mining grants acceptance to the second-degree (master's) study of this major. In summary, Mining Engineering is a comprehensive course of study offered at AGH University.
description.Wydzia\u0142 In\u017cynierii Metali i In: The Faculty of Metals Engineering and Industrial Computer Science at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a faculty/department within the university. It was formerly known as Wydział Metalurgii i Inżynierii Materiałowej, before being renamed in 2005.
description.ELEKTROTECHNIKA: The undergraduate major in Electrical Engineering at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a first-cycle (Bachelor's) study program focusing on electrotechnics. It is a course offered at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering (WEAIiIB). The field of study is electrical engineering, and it is a related major often pursued by graduates of the 'Elektronika' (Electronics) program.
description.URSS:
The entity is a student organization at AGH University, likely known as "Uczelniana Rada Samorządu Studentów" (URSS), which translates to University Student Self-Government.  It functions as the university-level student government organization.  Its responsibilities include:

*   Setting and determining the allocation of funds for student activities, including the Grant Rektora program.
*   Being consulted on financial matters related to the Grant Rektora.
*   Sending student delegates to the Grant Committee and WRSS (likely another student organization).

It also functions as a student research organization.
description.WH: The Faculty of Humanities (Wydział Humanistyczny) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a faculty within the university. The abbreviation for Faculty of Humanities is Wydział Humanistyczny.
description.PROREKTOR AGH: The Vice-Rector position at AGH University of Science and Technology is a leadership role within the university administration. It is responsible for specific areas and aspects of the university's operations. Notably, Michał Odlanicki-Poczobutt currently holds the position. Wacław Adam Leskiewicz held the position from 1961-1964. The Vice-Rector's office is located within AGH University.
description.KN: KN, or Koło Naukowe, is a student research group or student scientific circle at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is also referred to as Studenckie Koło Naukowe. The term represents an organization dedicated to academic and research activities. Often abbreviated as KN and followed by numbers (e.g., KN123).
description.KOMISJA PROPAGANDOWA KOMITETU OBCHODU 50: This is the AGH Committee responsible for managing, organizing, and promoting the 50th anniversary celebrations of AGH. It included a Propaganda Committee specifically tasked with promoting the university's anniversary events.
description.WGGIOS AGH: The Wydział Geologii, Geofizyki i Ochrony Środowiska (Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection) is a faculty/department at AGH University of Science and Technology. The acronym "Wydział Geologii, Geofizyki i Ochrony Środowiska" refers to this entity. It appears to be related to the administration of information and may also be associated with the Faculty of Mining Surveying and Environmental Engineering.
description.AGH RAPID PROTOTYPING: This entity encompasses a multifaceted student initiative at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), primarily operating within the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics. It includes several student scientific circles and research groups focused on rapid prototyping technologies. A key area of focus is 3D printing, with exploration into its capabilities and the use of low-melting-point materials. Specific applications include developing research tools for sports equipment and utilizing 3D printing in robotics projects. The entity also incorporates a rapid prototyping laboratory, offering practical experience and resources in these technologies. Therefore, this entity can be described as a combination of student-led organizations, clubs, laboratories, and projects all related to the advancement and application of rapid prototyping, especially 3D printing, within AGH.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Humanistyczny: The Faculty of Humanities is a department (or faculty) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST).
description.KATEDRA AUTOMATYZACJI PROCES\u00d3W: The Department of Process Automation at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a department within the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics. It focuses on process automation and was headed by Janusz Kowal from 1994 to 2015. The department also organizes related courses.
description.KOMISJA:
This entity is a **COMMITTEE** at AGH University responsible for various evaluation and decision-making processes related to funding and scholarship applications. Its responsibilities include:

*   Reviewing and making recommendations regarding scholarship applications in general.
*   Evaluating applications and making funding decisions for the "Dofinansowanie badań w zakresie projektów dyplomowych oraz prac dyplomowych" program (funding for research in diploma projects and diploma theses).
*   Evaluating applicants for the Stypendium Fundacji H.T. Zielińskich scholarship.
*   Handling student applications for the Erasmus program.
*   Managing the ranking procedure and decision-making for grant funding for student scientific circles, specifically for the "Konkurs Dofinansowanie Projektów Kół Naukowych" program.
*   Assessing funding applications within the IDUB (Initiative of Excellence – Research University) program.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Maszyn G\u00f3rniczych i Hu: The Faculty of Mining and Metallurgy Machines at AGH University of Science and Technology, also referred to as the Faculty of Mining and Metallurgical Machinery at AGH UST, was established in 1957 as the Faculty of Mining and Metallurgy Mechanization. It is a faculty of AGH University of Science and Technology, and a former name of the Wydział Inżynierii Mechanicznej i Robotyki.
description.HRS4R: The Human Resources Strategy for Researchers (HRS4R) is a European program and procedure aimed at improving employment and working conditions for researchers in Europe. It supports research institutions in implementing the European Charter for Researchers and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers (Charter & Code) in their policies and practices. AGH University adheres to the Human Resources Strategy for Researchers initiative and has attained HRS4R accreditation, indicating its commitment to creating attractive employment and recruitment conditions for researchers. The implementation of HRS4R at AGH University likely involves the European Charter for Researchers.
description.WI: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) houses various organizational units, including faculties and departments. Specifically, the **Faculty of Computer Science (Wydział Informatyki)**, often abbreviated as **WI**, is a prominent faculty within AGH UST. Other faculties include the **Faculty of Foundry Engineering** and the **Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics**. All of these constitute important organizations within the broader university structure.
description.REWITALIZACJA TEREN\u00d3W ZDEGRADOWANYC: Revitalization of Degraded Areas is a relatively new major (Rewitalizacja Terenów Zdegradowanych) offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is a unique and first-cycle (undergraduate) study program focusing on the revitalization of degraded areas. The program is part of the Faculty of Civil Engineering and Resource Management and was added to the faculty's offering in 2019. This major is also referred to as a course within AGH University.
description.BaDAP AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) maintains a bibliographic database system. This system, referred to as AGH's Bibliographic and Data Access Platform or AGH's Bibliographic and Digital Archive Platform, serves as a comprehensive resource for cataloging, managing, and searching publications and research outputs produced by AGH researchers. It contains information about both the publications and their authors at AGH, acting as a repository of this information.
description.KATEDRA ZASTOSOWA\u0143 FIZYKI J\u0104DR: The Department of Applications of Nuclear Physics is a department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It's also sometimes referred to as the Department of Nuclear Physics Applications. The department is part of the Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science (Wydział Fizyki i Informatyki Stosowanej) and focuses on the applications of nuclear physics.
description.KATEDRA METALURGII STALI: The Department of Steel Metallurgy is a department within the Faculty of Metallurgy at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH). Feliks Olszak was a lecturer and head of the Department of Steel Metallurgy at AGH.
description.MIKROELEKTRONIKA W TECHNICE I MEDYCYNIE: Microelectronics in Technology and Medicine is a major (or course of study) offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is a first-cycle (undergraduate) program. The field of study focuses on the development and application of microelectronics in both technology and medicine.
description.WFiIS: The Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is also referred to as Wydział Fizyki i Informatyki Stosowanej in Polish. A voting system is used at this faculty.
description.Miasteczko Studenckie AGH: The AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH) operates a student campus comprising a student housing complex. This campus includes dormitories and various student clubs, offering accommodation and facilities for students. The area is managed by AGH and serves as the primary student residential area.
description.KOSZULKA CZARNA 100-LECIE: This is a black T-shirt commemorating the 100th anniversary of AGH University of Science and Technology. It is available for purchase in the AGH E-sklep (AGH e-shop). The t-shirt features the 100th-anniversary AGH logo.
description.SCOPUS: This is a bibliographic database (RESOURCE, DATABASE, SYSTEM) containing abstracts and citations for academic literature, including journal articles, books, and conference proceedings. It is a large abstract and citation database of peer-reviewed scholarly literature. Specifically, it is Elsevier's abstract and citation database.
description.RADA PROGRAMOWA:
The Program Council is a committee within AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) that serves as an advisory body and plays a key role in shaping various aspects of the university's activities. Its responsibilities span multiple areas, including:

*   **Academic Programs:** Overseeing and advising on academic programs within faculties, shaping the curriculum and educational process for specific fields of study.
*   **Program Management:** Guiding and managing specific AGH programs such as the AGH NAUKA SPOTKANIA program and the Program Power 3.5 project.
*   **Collaboration:** Fostering collaboration between the Faculty of Computer Science and the socio-economic environment in didactic and scientific aspects.
*   **Student Organizations:** Setting the agenda and activities for student organizations like the Klub Przedsiębiorcy AGH.

In summary, the Program Council is a multifaceted committee involved in academic oversight, program management, fostering collaboration, and guiding student initiatives within AGH.
description.ZAK\u0141AD NANOIN\u017bYNIERII POWIERZC: The Department of Surface Nanoengineering and Biomaterials is a department and laboratory at AGH University located within the Academic Centre for Materials and Nanotechnology (ACMiN). It focuses on research related to surface nanoengineering and biomaterials. The department also houses the Laboratory of Surface Nanoengineering and Biomaterials.
description.FACULTY OF APPLIED MATHEMATICS: The entity is a **Faculty** at **AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST)**, also referred to as **AGH University of Krakow** or simply **AGH University**. It is dedicated to **research and education in applied mathematics**, focusing on applied mathematics studies. It is an academic unit within the university.
description.CMENTARZ RAKOWICKI: The entity is a historical cemetery located in Krakow, known as Rakowicki Cemetery. It serves as a burial site for notable figures, including professors and faculty from AGH University of Science and Technology. Specifically, individuals like Zygmunt Bielski-Saryusz and Roman Ney are buried there, among other prominent figures connected to AGH. It's a frequently used site for burial services of AGH faculty and staff.
description.RAFA\u0141 WI\u015aNIOWSKI: The entity is a person holding the position of Prorector for Cooperation at AGH University of Science and Technology. This person is also referred to as Vice-Rector for Cooperation at AGH University and Prorector of AGH for Collaboration. In 2025, the person held the position of Prorector for Cooperation at AGH University of Science and Technology / Vice-Rector for Cooperation at AGH University of Krakow. The current office holder is prof. dr hab. inż., who also acts as the Project Manager for Zintegrowany Program Rozwoju Akademii Górniczo-Hutniczej w Krakowie.
description.Poczta AGH: AGH University provides an email service for its students and staff. This email system serves as the university's internal email platform. The credentials used for accessing the email system are the same credentials used for Wi-Fi access.
description.UPEL: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) utilizes a SYSTEM of e-learning platforms for online learning, course management, delivery of educational resources, and conducting assessments. This system includes an instance or customized version of Moodle, as well as potentially other e-learning platforms used alongside or integrated with Moodle. The platforms facilitate course delivery, access to course materials, internship information, and online exams.
description.PRAKTYKI: AGH University offers a variety of internship opportunities for its students. These internships can be mandatory or optional, depending on the faculty, such as the Faculty of Management. Internship opportunities are offered at the Academic Centre for Materials and Nanotechnology (Akademickie Centrum Materiałów i Nanotechnologii) and provided by partner companies like Wienerberger. These internships serve as practical training programs for AGH students.
description.PE\u0141NOMOCNIK REKTORA DS. K\u00d3\u01: The Rector's Representative for Student Research Groups at AGH is a position responsible for overseeing and supporting student research groups within the university. This role involves overseeing and approving funding for Student Research Group projects. Currently, this position is held by dr inż. Joanna Augustyn-Nadzieja. The Rector appoints the representative.
description.MBA TECH: The MBA TECH program at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow is a two-year, postgraduate Master of Business Administration program offered by AGH Business School. This innovative MBA program is focused on technology and its application in business, integrating technology, engineering, computer science, human sciences, and business principles. The program is taught in English and designed for individuals seeking to enhance their skills in the technology sector.
description.MIASTECZKO STUDENCKIE: The entity is a student housing complex, specifically a student campus area located at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow. This campus primarily serves as a dormitory complex providing accommodation for students. The campus is not exclusively for AGH students, also accommodating students from various universities in Krakow. It offers dormitory accommodations and assistant hotels.
description.MUZEUM AGH: The Museum of AGH, also known as the AGH UST Museum or the Museum of History at AGH University of Science and Technology, is AGH University's museum. It is a museum associated with AGH University and potentially contains historical documents and artifacts related to the university's history.
description.MXENE IN LEO: This experiment, a project and part of the IGNIS mission to the International Space Station, was developed at AGH University of Science and Technology's Center of Space Technologies. The experiment focuses on researching MXenes, modern nanomaterials, and testing their stability in low-Earth orbit (LEO). The specific experiment conducted examines the properties of MXenes and their potential applications in future space missions.
description.UBPO:
AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) offers a range of services and programs to support its students and faculty. These include:

*   **Uniwersyteckie Biuro Pomocy Prawnej - University Legal Aid Office:** Provides legal assistance.
*   **Uniwersyteckie Biuro Promocji i Obsługi (University Promotion and Service Office):** Handles promotion and service-related matters.
*   **Uniwersyteckie Biuro Projektów i Obsługi Grantów (University Project and Grant Office):** Supports project and grant-related activities.
*   **Uczelniana Baza Przedmiotów Obieralnych - University Database of Elective Courses:** A university-wide database of elective courses designed to enhance the flexibility and attractiveness of the educational offerings at AGH. It allows for flexible curriculum design and supplementation.

The provided text also mentions **Uniwersytecka Biblioteka Politechniki Opolskiej**, which is the University Library of Opole University of Technology, a separate institution. While listed in the input, it's not directly related to AGH's services or programs.
description.POLISH LANGUAGE COURSE: AGH University offers a Polish language course specifically designed for international students. This course aims to help non-Polish speaking students learn the Polish language.
description.SOCJOLOGIA: Sociology is a major study program offered by the Faculty of Humanities at AGH University of Science and Technology. It is one of the initial study programs offered by the Faculty and focuses on understanding social phenomena and using technology in various economic areas. The major emphasizes practical applications within a technical university setting. It is available as an undergraduate major.
description.POLISH NATIONAL AGENCY FOR ACADEMIC EXCH: The entity in question is a national agency in Poland dedicated to supporting and funding international education programs and the internationalization of Polish higher education. It channels funds from the Ministry of Education and Science to Polish universities for specific programs, such as the UNESCO Fellowship and SPINAKER. The agency promotes academic exchange programs and provides general support for internationalization efforts within Polish higher education institutions.
description.A-0: The Main Building of AGH is a facility located on the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) campus at Aleja Adama Mickiewicza 30 in Krakow. It houses various offices and services, including the Dział Informacji i Promocji AGH (Information and Promotion Department) and the secretariat for Rada Dyscypliny Nauki o Ziemi i Środowisku (Council of the Discipline of Earth and Environment Sciences). The building is associated with the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection. Architectural accessibility details for the building are available.
description.FACULTY OF NON-FERROUS METALS: The entity is a Faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) in Krakow. It is focused on non-ferrous metals studies and is responsible for the implementation of the cooperation agreement with WITI.
description.FELIKS OLSZAK: This person was a Professor at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), specializing in steel metallurgy. They served as the Rector of AGH UST from 1958 to 1961. They were a significant figure affiliated with AGH.
description.FIZYKA TECHNICZNA: Technical Physics is a major offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), specifically by the Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science (WFiIS). It's available at both undergraduate (first-cycle) and graduate levels. The program focuses on technical applications of physics, and is also a research topic within the university. It is offered as a course as well.
description.ZYGMUNT KOWALCZYK: This individual was a prominent figure at AGH University of Science and Technology, holding the position of Rector from 1950 to 1956. He was a Professor specializing in geodetics, particularly mining geodesy. His research interests also included photogrammetry and the mechanics of rock mass displacement ('Mechanika Przemieszczeń Górotworu'). He was associated with the Tachimetria discipline and Mining Surveying at AGH.  He was also awarded the title of Doctor Honoris Causa.
description.GRANT: This entity encompasses projects funded by internal or external sources, typically for research conducted by student research groups at AGH University of Science and Technology. This includes financial aid provided by AGH specifically for student projects, research grants used to conduct research at AGH, and research grants secured by AGH University or its researchers. A significant aspect of this entity are projects funded under the "Grant Rektora" program, which is a specific funding mechanism awarded by AGH, particularly the Rector's Grant, to support student projects. This entity can be classified as both a SCHOLARSHIP and a PROJECT, reflecting its dual nature as a source of financial support and a means of facilitating research activities.
description.PRYMUSI AGH: The entity is a PROGRAM at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) designed for top-performing students, including first-year undergraduate students and top candidates undertaking first and second cycle full-time studies. The program recognizes and supports high-achieving students, providing additional educational opportunities and benefits such as access to tutoring, additional courses, and free dormitory accommodation. It may also offer a special admission pathway or prioritize top-performing students from AGH-affiliated high schools or technical schools. The program aims to help these best students further excel.
description.KONWENT SENIOR\u00d3W AGH: The Council of Seniors at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is an organization and committee comprised of senior members and faculty members. It is co-organized and chaired by Zygmunt Kawecki.
description.POL-on: The entity is a **Polish system for monitoring science and higher education**. It is a **Polish research information system**, also referred to as **Polish system of Science information** and maintained by the **National Information Processing Institute**. This system is a **Polish scientific information system** used for reporting and accessing information about researchers and institutions. It is a **national system in Poland** used to gather and process information about higher education institutions, including data relevant to the evaluation of scientific activities. It also serves as a **Polish system for monitoring and evaluating science**.  The system acts as an **information system on science and higher education in Poland**, providing data on researchers, publications, and scientific institutions. It is **referenced on the Dańko Józef profile page**.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Wiertnictwa, Nafty i Gazu: The Faculty of Drilling, Oil and Gas at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a faculty/department that conducts research in environmental engineering, mining, and energy.  It is also responsible for organizing the postgraduate program.
description.KATEDRA TECHNOLOGII MATERIA\u0141\u00d3W: The Department of Building Materials Technology is a department within the Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics (Wydział Inżynierii Materiałowej i Ceramiki - WIMiC) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It specializes in building materials technology and was established in 2003.
description.KATEDRA TECHNOLOGII INFORMACYJNYCH I MED: The Department of Information Technology and Media is a department within the Faculty of Humanities (Wydział Humanistyczny) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH University). It is one of the three departments within the Faculty that focuses on information technology and media.
description.GEOLOGIA STOSOWANA: Applied Geology is a major and course offered at the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), specifically within the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection (WGGIOS). It is a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program that prepares students for careers in the geological, construction, or mining industries. The program focuses on prospecting, reconnaissance, and documentation of solid, liquid, and gaseous mineral deposits, and equips students with the skills to solve complex, interdisciplinary engineering problems. The course includes a focus on deposits.
description.CENTRUM SPRAW MI\u0118DZYNARODOWYCH AGH: The International Relations Office/Center for International Affairs at AGH University is a department/organization responsible for managing international partnerships and exchange programs. Its duties include handling international guests and related administrative processes, supporting international students and staff, and overseeing international collaborations.
description.TADEUSZ UHL: This person is a Professor at AGH University and the Director of the Centrum Technologii Kosmicznych (Center of Space Technology) at AGH University. They are an expert in space technology and lead a team at the Centrum Technologii Kosmicznych. They are also involved in robotics research at AGH and lead research alongside Xiaoqian Gao. Furthermore, they are part of the research team for the MXene in LEO experiment.
description.KATEDRA CHEMII KRZEMIAN\u00d3W I ZWI\u01: The Department of Chemistry of Silicates and Macromolecular Compounds is a department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is located within the Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics (WIMiC). Established in 1994, it evolved from the former Department of Silicate Chemistry at AGH, becoming the Chair of Silicate Chemistry and Macromolecular Compounds. The department focuses on research and education related to the chemistry of silicates and macromolecular compounds.
description.CERAMIKA: Ceramics is a major, course, and discipline/specialization at AGH University of Science and Technology, specifically within the Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics. It is a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program focusing on both classical and modern technologies in ceramics, glass production, and industrial design. The program emphasizes the design and technology of ceramics.
description.POLITECHNIKA WARSZAWSKA: The Warsaw University of Technology is an organization and a collaborating institution with AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It was the location of a conference and a participant in a webinar. Tadeusz Kaczorek was awarded an honorary doctorate by the Warsaw University of Technology. Henryk Bogowid Korwin-Krukowski was one of the founders of Warsaw University of Technology.
description.LABORATORIUM MASZYNOWE: The Machine Laboratory at AGH University of Science and Technology is a specialized facility dedicated to research and education in mechanical engineering. Located at ul. Reymonta 7, it was established in 1926, largely due to the contribution of Professor Edmund Chromiński and funded by mining taxes.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Metalurgiczny: The Faculty of Metallurgy at AGH University of Science and Technology (also referred to as Faculty of Metallurgy at AGH University) is a faculty within AGH University. It was formed after the transformation of Wydział Hutniczy in 1952. The faculty's former names include Faculty of Metallurgy at AGH, later renamed to Wydział Inżynierii Metali i Informatyki Przemysłowej, and Wydział Metalurgii i Inżynierii Materiałowej.
description.OPEN AGH: AGH University of Science and Technology provides open educational resources (OER) through a dedicated platform and as a broader initiative. This platform serves as a repository for various open resources, including e-courses, e-textbooks, and multimedia materials. The initiative focuses on the systematic sharing of these resources. This system is part of a program within AGH University.
description.AGH DRONE ENGINEERING: This entity is a Student Research Group (also referred to as a Student Scientific Circle and Student Research Group) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). Located at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics, it focuses on drone engineering, design, and construction.  The group's activities encompass the development of drones and their applications, including unmanned systems designed to support search and rescue operations and drone development specifically for medical transport.
description.AGH UNIVERSITY ONLINE STORE: The AGH University online store is the official online platform where students, alumni, and staff can purchase various products and services, including AGH-branded merchandise. It offers a range of items related to the AGH University of Science and Technology.
description.STUDIA DOKTORANCKIE: AGH University of Science and Technology offers Doctoral (PhD) studies programs at the doctoral level. These programs lead to a doctoral degree and are available across various disciplines. They are designed for students seeking a doctoral degree.
description.INSTYTUT GEOLOGII I SUROWC\u00d3W MINERA: The Institute of Geology and Mineral Resources is a department at AGH University (AGH University of Science and Technology). It was formerly associated with AGH and previously a department within the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection (formerly the Faculty of Geological Prospecting). The institute focuses on geological research and mineral resources. Tadeusz Słomka began his career at the Institute.
description.DOM STUDENCKI: These are student dormitories, located within Miasteczko Studenckie AGH, that provide accommodation for students of AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). description.IN\u017bYNIERIA I OCHRONA \u015aRODOWISK: Environmental Engineering and Protection is a major (also referred to as a course and program of study) offered at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It was also known as the Department of Foundry Technology at AGH UST. Currently, it is a former faculty, and its functions are now part of the Wydział Odlewnictwa (Faculty of Foundry Engineering).
description.ZBIGNIEW OSI\u0143SKI: This individual is a Professor specializing in mechanics, particularly non-linear mechanical vibrations and machine dynamics/design. He is associated with the Mechanika department at AGH University. He is also known for his contributions to the theory of vibrations and construction, and structural theory. He received the Doctor Honoris Causa from AGH in 1995.
description.JM REKTOR AGH: The Rector of AGH University of Science and Technology is the highest authority of the university and holds the highest executive authority. The office of Rector of AGH is responsible for issuing directives (Zarządzenia) concerning university management and policies. The Rector also approves housing rates within the Miasteczko Studenckie AGH.
description.Politechnika \u015al\u0105ska: The Silesian University of Technology is a technical university located in Gliwice. It's a partner institution and was the workplace of professor Stefan Węgrzyn. Eugeniusz Świtoński also worked at the Silesian University of Technology before becoming a professor.
description.FACULTY OF DRILLING, OIL AND GAS: The Faculty is one of the faculties at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST), located in Krakow. It specializes in education, research, and cooperation related to drilling, oil, and gas engineering. The faculty is focused on drilling, oil, and gas studies.
description.ANDRZEJ \u0141\u0118DZKI: This person is a Professor at AGH University of Science and Technology, specializing in metallurgy, iron extractive metallurgy, environmental engineering, and applied computer science. They have held significant leadership positions within the university, including serving as Prorector ds. Ogólnych (Vice-Rector for General Affairs) and Vice-Rector for Education. They have been awarded the title of 'Profesor Honorowy AGH' (Honorary Professor of AGH) and the Brązowy Krzyż Zasługi (Bronze Cross of Merit) in recognition of their contributions to AGH.
description.ENERGETYKA J\u0104DROWA: Nuclear Power Engineering is a major (field of study) and course at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) focused on nuclear energy. It is offered as a second-cycle study program.
description.BLACK T-SHIRT 100 YEARS OF AGH UST: This is a black T-shirt commemorating the 100th anniversary (centenary) of AGH University of Science and Technology. It is a specific product sold in the AGH e-Sklep and features the 100th anniversary logo of AGH.
description.KRZYSZTOF MENDROK: This individual is a professor at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). They are the current Vice-Rector for Education (Prorector ds. Kształcenia) at AGH. They are also the Chairman of the Program Council and are associated with both the Mechanika department and Automatyka i Robotyka at AGH.
description.WOJCIECH HUBERT \u017bUREK: This person is a Professor and Doctor Honoris Causa of AGH University of Science and Technology. Their expertise spans several areas of physics, including physics, quantum physics, statistical physics, astrophysics, cosmology, and quantum informatics. They are a representative and researcher in quantum physics, astrophysics, and quantum computer science at AGH, making them a significant academic and researcher within the institution.
description.WYDZIA\u0141OWY ZESP\u00d3\u0141 DS. REK: AGH University has faculty-specific recruitment committees or teams, categorized as ORGANIZATIONS or COMMITTEES, dedicated to managing student admissions. These exist within various faculties, including the Faculty of Non-Ferrous Metals (Wydział Metali Nieżelaznych), the Faculty of Drilling, Oil and Gas, and the Faculty of Humanities. Their responsibilities include reviewing applications and overseeing admissions processes specific to their faculty's area of study and undertaking recruitment activities.
description.PBN: Polska Bibliografia Naukowa (Polish Scientific Bibliography), also known as Polish Scientific Bibliography - Polska Bibliografia Naukowa, is an external system designed for collecting and disseminating information about scientific publications in Poland. It is referenced on the Dańko Józef profile page.
description.CHUSTA TUBA #JESTEMZAGH: This is a multifunctional neck gaiter or tube scarf, also described as a sport scarf, featuring the #jestemzAGH (I am from AGH) hashtag. It is available for purchase in the AGH E-sklep (AGH e-shop).
description.DZIA\u0141ANIE 12: This is a specific project within the "Inicjatywa Doskonałości" (IDUB) program, categorized as both a program and a project. It focuses on integrating education with scientific research. This integration is supported through multiple specific actions, including providing funding for diploma projects and theses, and especially concerning student research groups. The project also aims to support innovative teaching.
description.J\u00d3ZEF NIZIO\u0141: This individual is a person connected to the history of AGH University, potentially as an alumnus, faculty member, or staff member. They are associated with the Mechanika department at AGH University and hold the title of Professor. Their specialization lies in the fields of mechanics, machine dynamics, theoretical mechanics, technical mechanics, and vibration isolation. They are also a Doctor Honoris Causa of AGH. Furthermore, they represent the Wibroizolacja (Vibration Isolation) area and are a representative of the 'Dynamika Maszyn' (Machine Dynamics) research area at AGH.
description.IN\u017bYNIER: The Inżynieria Metali Nieżelaznych (Non-Ferrous Metals Engineering) program at AGH University offers graduates engineering job opportunities. Completion of the first cycle of studies (lasting 7 semesters) leads to an Engineer's degree, a professional degree attainable at the Bachelor's level. This engineering degree is awarded upon completion of the first-cycle studies.
description.INTRANET BG: The AGH Main Library (Biblioteka Główna AGH) operates an internal network system. This system is specifically for the use of the library staff and supports their operations. It provides access to internal resources and communication channels necessary for the library's functioning. It is an internal network or portal exclusively for employees of the AGH Main Library.
description.Nr albumu: The Student Identification Number (also referred to as Student ID number at AGH UST or Student Identification Number in the AGH UST) is a unique identifier assigned by the university to each student. It is used within the university's systems, procedures, and by student organizations.
description.FACULTY OF METALS ENGINEERING AND INDUST: The entity is a **FACULTY** at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) located in Krakow. It is one of the faculties at the university and an academic unit. Its areas of focus include metals engineering and industrial computer science.
description.ERASMUS: This is an international student exchange program, including a European Union student exchange program, that facilitates student mobility between AGH (AGH University of Science and Technology) and partner universities. The program allows students to study at different universities within Europe and facilitates cooperation between AGH and UTV (presumably another university). A specific instance of this type of program is the student exchange program between UTV and AGH, initiated by Jean Raymond Gavarri.
description.ERASMUS+ KA171: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) participates in several international academic exchange programs, including Erasmus+.  Specifically, AGH UST facilitates student exchange programs for both EU and non-EU countries.  A distinct branch of the Erasmus+ program at AGH focuses on mobilities with Third Countries Not Associated to the Programme, providing opportunities for students to study and exchange with countries outside the Erasmus+ Programme's associated countries. This Erasmus+ branch facilitates mobility and exchange opportunities with these non-associated countries.
description.PE\u0141NOMOCNIK REKTORA DS. REKRUTACJI: This person is the Rector's representative for recruitment matters at AGH University. They are responsible for decisions regarding the admission of first-year students and oversee the entire recruitment process on behalf of the Rector. They are authorized to conduct recruitment procedures for first-year students.
description.MICHA\u0141 ODLANICKI-POCZOBUTT: This individual is a professor at AGH University of Science and Technology, specializing in geodesy and spatial planning. They have held significant positions within the university, including Prorector and Vice-Rector. Furthermore, they have been recognized with the Krzyż Komandorski z Gwiazdą Orderu Odrodzenia Polski. Their expertise lies in both geodesy and spatial planning, making them a prominent figure in these fields at AGH.
description.COMPUTER PHYSICS: Computer Physics is a first-cycle (Bachelor's level) interdisciplinary study program offered at the Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). The program combines physics and computer science with a focus on computational methods in physics.
description.Biuro Administracyjne Wydzia\u0142u: The Faculty Administrative Office at AGH UST (AGH University of Science and Technology) serves as the Administrative Office of the Faculty, handling administrative tasks. Specifically, it is the Administrative Office of the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection and more generally provides administrative support for the faculty as a whole. It is a department within the organization of AGH.
description.TOMIS\u0141AW MARIAN MORAWSKI: This person is a mining engineer and holds the title of Doctor Honoris Causa from AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). He is recognized for significant contributions to the Polish mining industry. He is affiliated with AGH, specifically the Górnictwo (Mining) program or department. Biographical information about him can be found in the 'Historia AGH' resource, suggesting he is a faculty member, student, or alumnus.
description.INSTYTUT MECHANIKI I WIBROAKUSTYKI AGH: The entity is the Institute of Mechanics and Vibroacoustics at AGH University of Science and Technology. It is a department (or a department within an institute) at AGH University focused on research in mechanics and vibroacoustics.
description.STANIS\u0141AW ZYGMUNT MROWEC: This person is a Professor at AGH University of Science and Technology, specializing in chemistry, materials engineering, and solid-state physical chemistry. They are a representative in the field of solid-state physical chemistry at AGH and are associated with Chemistry at AGH. They have been awarded the title of 'Profesor Honorowy AGH'.
description.DOCTOR HONORIS CAUSA AGH: An honorary doctorate is a degree awarded by the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH University) for significant contributions and achievements to science and society, as well as science and technology.
description.MODERN MATERIALS DESIGN AND APPLICATION: Modern Materials Design and Application is a master's level field of study offered at the Faculty of Non-Ferrous Metals (Wydział Metali Nieżelaznych) at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). This major, taught in English, focuses on the design and application of modern materials. It is also offered as a course.
description.ZARZ\u0104DZANIE I IN\u017bYNIERIA PRODU: Management and Production Engineering is a major offered at the Faculty of Management at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is a first-cycle (undergraduate) study program focusing on the combination of management and production engineering principles. It can be referred to as both a major and a course of study.
description.JEAN RAYMOND GAVARRI: This person is a Professor and chemist at AGH University, specializing in solid-state chemistry and oxide materials. They are a representative of the Chemia Ciała Stałego (Solid State Chemistry) research area. Furthermore, they have been awarded the title of Honorary Consul of AGH.
description.SHIBAURA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY: AGH University of Science and Technology has a strategic partnership with a Japanese university located in Tokyo. This university is a key partner for AGH UST in Japan, facilitating both research and academic exchange programs. The partnership involves collaborative efforts on research and various academic initiatives.
description.DOKUMENTY AGH: This is a resource, specifically a central repository of documents related to AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It contains important official documents, administrative materials, and regulations pertaining to the university's operations.
description.I LOVE AGH: This is a brand associated with AGH University of Science and Technology, used on various merchandise items like bags, apparel, and white sports socks to promote school pride and indicate affiliation or support for the university. The graphic design or slogan is featured on merchandise sold in the AGH e-shop, representing AGH-related branding.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Geodezji G\u00f3rniczej: The entity is the Faculty of Mining Surveying at AGH University (also referred to as the Faculty of Mining Surveying at AGH University of Science and Technology). At one point, Stanisław Gołąb headed the Department of Mathematics within the faculty. The entity is a FACULTY.
description.PRZEGL\u0104D G\u00d3RNICZO-HUTNICZY: Mining and Metallurgy Review is an academic journal related to mining and metallurgy. Henryk Bogowid Korwin-Krukowski served as the editor of the metallurgical section of the journal. He edited the journal within the metallurgy department.
description.ZAK\u0141AD CHEMII KRZEMIAN\u00d3W: The entity is the **Department of Silicate Chemistry** at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH). It is a **department** within the **Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics** at AGH. The department also functions as a **laboratory** within the Instytut Chemii Ciała Stałego, focusing on silicate chemistry. It existed as a department from 1987 to 1990. Later, the Department of Silicate Chemistry was transformed into a chair. Mirosław Handke began his career at the Department of Silicate Chemistry.
description.Studium J\u0119zyk\u00f3w Obcych: The entity is a **DEPARTMENT** known under several names, all related to language education at AGH University of Science and Technology. These names include: **Foreign Languages Centre at AGH, providing language courses for students, Foreign Language Study Center at AGH, Foreign Language Study Center at AGH University of Science and Technology, Foreign Language Study Center at AGH, and Foreign Language Study Department.** The primary function of this department is to provide language courses for students at AGH.
description.STUDIA PIERWSZEGO STOPNIA: AGH University of Science and Technology offers first-cycle studies (Bachelor's degree programs) leading to the Inżynier (engineer) or Licencjat (Bachelor) title. These programs last typically 7 semesters and lead to an engineering degree.
description.CENTRUM KOMUNIKACJI I MARKETINGU AGH: The AGH Communication and Marketing Center is a department/organization within AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). Its primary functions include promoting the university and managing communication and marketing activities. A key responsibility of the center is managing the Honorary Patronage process, including all related communication.
description.KONFERENCJA: AGH hosts and participates in various academic and scientific conferences. These include a recurring conference, possibly related to library science or a related field and potentially hosted by Biblioteka Glowna AGH. There is also a scientific conference held as part of the 'Dzień Hutnika' celebration. Members of AGH either attend or organize other academic conferences as well. Furthermore, AGH might be associated with a series of scientific conferences initiated in the 1980s at the University of Technology and Life Sciences in Bydgoszcz, which focuses on signal processing in telecommunications, control, and monitoring.
description.#JESTEMZAGH T-SHIRT: This is a T-shirt sold in the AGH e-Sklep (AGH store) that promotes affiliation with AGH University of Science and Technology. It is branded with the hashtag "#jestemzAGH" (I am from AGH), a common expression of association with the university.
description.AGH UNIVERSITY RECTOR: The Rector of AGH University holds the highest administrative position at the university and is the leading academic and administrative officer. This position is currently held by Professor Jerzy Lis. As the head of AGH University, the Rector is responsible for issuing orders and regulations. The Rector also serves as the highest authority of AGH University, with responsibilities including appointing and revoking members of the Programme Board.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Fizyki i Techniki J\u0105dr: The Faculty of Physics and Nuclear Technology is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is also known as the Faculty of Physics and Nuclear Technology at AGH University. Formerly, it was named the Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science at AGH University.
description.SPORTS T-SHIRT 100 YEARS OF AGH UST: This is a commemorative sports T-shirt produced specifically for the 100th anniversary of AGH University of Science and Technology. It is sold in the AGH e-Sklep and features the logo of the 100th anniversary. It is considered a resource, specifically sports apparel.
description.KATEDRA AUTOMATYKI I ROBOTYKI: The Department of Automation and Robotics is a department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is located within the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering at AGH. The department's main focus is automation and robotics.
description.GEOINFORMATYKA: AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) offers a comprehensive program in Geoinformatics. This includes a first-cycle (undergraduate) major in Geoinformatics offered by WGGIOS (likely a department or faculty at AGH). The Geoinformatics course focuses on modern geoinformatics technologies, Earth sciences, and spatial and environmental data. It covers acquisition, analysis, visualization, and modeling of spatial data, incorporating current trends and relevant IT technologies. There is also a student research group at AGH UST focused on geoinformatics and surveying projects.
description.KIEJSTUT \u017bEMAITIS: This individual was a professor at AGH University of Science and Technology, specializing in metallurgy and electrometallurgy of steel. They served as the Rector of AGH from 1963 to 1969. Furthermore, they were awarded the Krzyż Komandorski z Gwiazdą Orderu Odrodzenia Polski (Commander's Cross with Star of the Order of Polonia Restituta). As Rector, they presented the Doctor Honoris Causa to Georgij Kurdiumow.
description.ROK AKADEMICKI 2024\/2025: The entity represents the academic year 2024/2025 at AGH University of Science and Technology. It defines the period of study for that specific academic year.
description.NARODOWE CENTRUM BADA\u0143 I ROZWOJU: The National Centre for Research and Development (NCBR) is a Polish government agency that supports and co-finances research and development projects in Poland. It co-funds research projects and specific projects such as 'Akademia Dostępności Plus' and the CCUS project.
description.KATEDRA GEOMECHANIKI, BUDOWNICTWA I GEOT: The Department of Geomechanics, Construction and Geotechnics is a department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It focuses on geomechanics, construction, and geotechnical engineering. Its name can also be Department of Geomechanics, Civil Engineering and Geotechnics.
description.WYDZIA\u0141 ELEKTROMECHANICZNY: The entity is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) called the Faculty of Electromechanical Engineering (formerly the Faculty of Electromechanics). Wacław Olszak served as Vice-Dean and Deputy Dean at this faculty. Adam Morecki is an alumnus of AGH, having completed his studies at a former faculty of the university, likely the Faculty of Electromechanical Engineering or its predecessor.
description.DOKTORAT WDRO\u017bENIOWY: The Implementation Doctorate program at AGH University is a specific type of doctoral program designed for industry professionals. This PhD program combines academic research with practical application and implementation in an industry setting, often in collaboration with industry partners. It focuses on the practical application and implementation of research findings. The program is relevant to members of Zespół ZIM.
description.DS14 KAPITOL: MS AGH is a dormitory complex within AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It comprises several dormitories, one of which is designated primarily for students from the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Biomedical Engineering (WEAIiIB), the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics, Computer Science and Electronics (WIEiT), and the Faculty of Informatics (WI).
description.REPOZYTORIUM AGH: The Digital Repository of AGH University of Science and Technology is a system and a library resource. It serves as an institutional repository located in Krakow. The repository is designed for collecting, disseminating, preserving, storing, and sharing AGH's research output, publications, research materials, educational materials, and other scholarly content of the university. It provides access to these scientific and educational outputs. It is managed by AGH University.
The "National Reading Development Program 2.0" (or "National Program for the Development of Readership 2.0") is a Polish initiative (running from 2021-2025) aimed at supporting library development and promoting reading. It provided co-funding for the implementation of the ALMA system at Biblioteka Główna AGH (AGH Main Library).
description.HYPE: This is a nanosatellite project, specifically a CubeSat mission, developed by students at AGH University of Science and Technology, particularly the SatLab AGH Student Research Group. It is the smallest Polish satellite. The satellite serves purposes of research, education, and inspiration. Its technology includes a spectrometer for hyperspectral Earth observation and a camera capable of taking selfies. This satellite project represents AGH's involvement in space endeavors.
description.ROMAN W\u0141ADYS\u0141AW KRAJEWSKI: This individual is a Professor at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) specializing in geology, including engineering geology, mineral deposit geology, and hydrogeology. They have held several significant positions within the university, including Prorector for Science (from 1958-1961) and Dean of the Faculty of Geology and Exploration. They also served as Vice-Rector for Science. Furthermore, they have been awarded the Krzyż Komandorski z Gwiazdą Orderu Odrodzenia Polski, a high-ranking Polish state decoration.
description.WIRTUALNA UCZELNIA: The Virtual University system is an AGH online service and e-learning platform used at AGH UST for online courses and educational resources. It functions as a Learning Management System (LMS). Notably, it is used by 3rd-year students at AGH University for scholarship applications, suggesting it also serves administrative purposes.
description.CENTRUM MI\u0118DZYNARODOWEJ PROMOCJI TE: The Center for International Promotion of Technology and Education at AGH University of Science and Technology is a department-level organization operating under the auspices of UNESCO. It is responsible for the international promotion of technology and education, specifically inspiring, coordinating, and supporting the exchange and transfer of engineering knowledge and practice, as well as university-level technical education. Its activities are primarily targeted towards developing countries and involve coordinating international collaborations, including the fellowship program and initiating IMPK programs. The Center operates in partnership with UNESCO.
description.G\u00d3RNICTWO: Mining is a major and field of research at AGH University of Science and Technology. Research on mining is published in a quarterly publication of AGH University and in the Polish scientific journal focused on mining. A notable textbook or publication on mining was authored by Witold Budryk.
description.Instytut Informatyki: The entity is a DEPARTMENT identified as the Institute of Computer Science (Instytut Informatyki). Specifically, it is the Institute of Computer Science at AGH UST (AGH University of Science and Technology), also known as Institute of Informatics within the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Automatics and Electronics. Notably, there was an "Institute at Politechnika Śląska" directed by Stefan Węgrzyn from 1972-1995, which, while relevant to the history of computer science in the region, is *not* identified as being the same entity.
description.SI\u0141OWNIA: The AGH University operates a gym facility located within the Basen AGH complex (AGH swimming pool). The gym offers fitness equipment and space for exercise and training.
description.MOODLE: UPeL is the primary e-learning platform used at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) for course management, content delivery, and student assessment. It is a popular, open-source learning management system (LMS) used for online courses and educational resources at AGH. The platform is likely based on a popular open-source LMS.
description.MIROS\u0141AW KARBOWNICZEK: The entity is a person who serves as the Prorector for General Affairs at AGH University of Science and Technology. They have also served as the Former Prorector ds. Ogólnych at AGH University of Science and Technology. Furthermore, they hold the title of Professor and head the Zespół d.s. Infrastruktury Badawczej at AGH.
description.WIMiIP: The Faculty of Metals Engineering and Industrial Computer Science at AGH UST (Akademia Górniczo-Hutnicza im. Stanisława Staszica w Krakowie) is a faculty and an organization within AGH University of Science and Technology. There seems to be a mix-up as Faculty of Materials Science and Ceramics at AGH UST is also mentioned in the context of Faculty of Metals Engineering and Industrial Computer Science at AGH UST.
description.KOLEGIUM WYDZIA\u0141U: The entity is a **COMMITTEE** known as a **Faculty Collegium** or **Faculty Council**. It functions as a governing and advisory body within a specific faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). Specifically, it exists within the Faculty of Non-Ferrous Metals and the Wydział Humanistyczny (Faculty of Humanities). The committee serves as an advisory board to the Dean of the faculty and is responsible for faculty-level governance and decision-making. Its composition includes deans, directors, representatives of employee groups, doctoral students, and students.
description.BUILD. A3: Building A3 is a facility located on the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) campus. It houses the AGH University Doctoral School, including its office.
description.WIMIR: The Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics (Wydział Inżynierii Mechanicznej i Robotyki) is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It is also a department, specifically the Department of Machine Design and Operation.
description.SYLLABUS AGH: This is the AGH University of Science and Technology's syllabus system, a resource and repository providing comprehensive information on course content, learning outcomes, assessment methods, curricula, and program details for various courses offered at the university. It serves as a database containing course information.
description.Wydzia\u0142 Mechanizacji G\u00f3rnictwa: The Faculty of Mining and Metallurgy Mechanization at AGH UST was a faculty focused on mechanization in mining and metallurgy that existed between 1952 and 1957. It was created in 1952 after the division of the Faculty of Electromechanics (Wydział Elektromechaniczny) into two separate faculties. This faculty later evolved into, or was incorporated into, other departments at AGH.
description.IGNACY MO\u015aCICKI: This person is associated with AGH University of Science and Technology. They are a Professor and Doctor Honoris Causa of AGH. The individual is a chemist and politician. They are also a former President of Poland. They were born in Mierzanów.
description.SYSTEM BIBLIOTECZNY ALMA: ALMA is a library management system used and implemented by Biblioteka Glowna AGH (the Main Library AGH). It is utilized for managing resources and various library operations.
description.LISTA KONTROLNA DO BADANIA DOST\u0118PNO: This document is the Digital Accessibility Checklist version 2.2, used by AGH University for self-assessment and general assessment of the digital accessibility of websites. It serves as a checklist to evaluate the accessibility of websites.
description.AGH.EDU.PL: AGH University of Science and Technology uses the agh.edu.pl domain as its primary online resource and network identifier. This domain serves as the official email domain for university communications and transactions. It hosts the main AGH website, providing information about programs and research, and acts as the primary domain for all AGH online services and email addresses. The official website, accessible through this domain, also provides information on the university's cookie policy. In essence, agh.edu.pl encompasses the university's websites, systems, and services.
description.WMN:
The entity is a faculty at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). Specifically, it encompasses:

*   Faculty of Applied Mathematics at AGH UST
*   Wydział Metali Nieżelaznych (Faculty of Non-Ferrous Metals), abbreviated in AGH's database.
*   Faculty of Mining and Geoengineering at AGH University of Science and Technology.
*   Faculty of Management at AGH UST.
description.PRACA DYPLOMOWA: This entity encompasses several aspects of academic work at AGH University related to the completion of a degree. It involves a **Diploma Thesis**, which is an **academic paper required to complete a degree**, specifically a **Diploma thesis for a second-cycle degree program**. The entity also includes a **Final Project**, and is referred to as **Diploma Thesis/Final Project course**. There is a **Course focused on preparing a scientific dissertation and presenting its effects**, indicating a structured learning component to guide students through the thesis process. Therefore, this entity can be categorized as a **DOCUMENT**, **COURSE**, **PUBLICATION**, and a **PROJECT**.
description.ZARZ\u0104DZANIE: The Faculty of Management at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) offers a first-cycle (undergraduate) major in Management. This Management program focuses on Management. There are also student research groups at AGH UST dedicated to Management, with some focusing additionally on industrial processes and optimization.
description.DZIA\u0141 DOST\u0118PNO\u015aCI: The Accessibility Department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) is a department within the university responsible for supporting people with specific needs and improving accessibility across the entire institution. The department is referred to as the Accessibility Department at AGH, Accessibility Department at AGH UST or Accessibility Department at AGH University.
description.A-4: Building A-4, also known as the Witold Budryk Pavilion, is a facility located on the AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) campus at al. Mickiewicza 30. It houses the Dean's Office and the Faculty of Drilling, Oil and Gas. The building also features accessibility features.
description.GEOTURYSTYKA: Geotourism at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST) encompasses multiple aspects related to the field. It's offered as a first-cycle (undergraduate) major, providing students with a comprehensive understanding of the tourism industry. The curriculum covers fundamentals of tourism, tourist traffic services (including organization and management of tourist events), guiding and piloting, and socio-psychological aspects of tourist traffic. The program is offered by the Faculty of Geology, Geophysics and Environmental Protection (WGGIOS). There is also student research group focused on geotourism.
description.INNOAGH: AGH University of Science and Technology fosters innovation and entrepreneurship through various avenues. These include an **ORGANIZATION** dedicated to promoting and supporting these activities, and a **PROGRAM** specifically designed to help students and researchers develop their ideas and entrepreneurial skills. The university also cultivates **PARTNERSHIP** with business partners to further its innovation goals. Furthermore, Krakowskie Centrum Innowacyjnych Technologii INNOAGH Sp. z o.o. (INNOAGH), a special purpose vehicle 100% owned by AGH, plays a crucial role in commercializing research and focusing on innovative technologies. It is an AGH-affiliated company.
description.KATEDRA INFORMATYKI STOSOWANEJ: The Department of Applied Computer Science is a department at AGH University of Science and Technology (AGH UST). It focuses on applied computer science.
